paper.title: Renewable and Cooling Aware Workload Management for Sustainable Data Centers
paper.authors: Liu, Chen, Bash, Wierman, et al.

sourced.note: SOURCED from paper abstract/Caltech record: up to 60% reductions in recurring power cost and non-renewable energy while meeting SLAs.

assumed.compare: VCC carbon day_ahead vs off on a high-PV case with location accounting
assumed.pass_rule: grid_import_or_cost does not increase; preferably decreases (directional). Full 60% not expected — different plant/cooling model.
assumed.note: ASSUMED we only test directional agreement (cost/import/carbon not worse under renewable-aware shaping). 60% is an upper bound from their full cooling+renewable co-optimization — intentional modeling difference if our Δ% << 60.
